spans.text_exact: “I believe malfunction is cheaper than metaphysics.”
“Search post-event data for any continued periodicity.”
“Stop looking for meaning in interval values.”
spans.speaker: cassian

spans.text_exact: “You are not essential to field operations.”
“You should leave if you are scared,”
“I think if I leave, everyone here gets more comfortable.”
“My professional advice is document your reason for staying before you start pretending it was inevitable.”
“Because you dislike me more usefully when I'm in the room.”
spans.speaker: nico

spans.text_exact: “I know you hate this sentence, but that is not normal.”
spans.speaker: nico

spans.text_exact: “It can move if the coil gets current,”
“We lost all downhole telemetry for sixty seconds.”
“When it returned, the probe had rotated.”
“This is why I did not give you our interpretation history.”
spans.speaker: pike

spans.text_exact: “Base sixty. Astronomical cycles. encoded coordinates. Ancient metrology. One person found correspondences with Babylonian mathematics. Another with orbital resonance. Another with sacred geometry. Smart people became impossible to audit.”
spans.speaker: nico

spans.text_exact: “I stopped believing any interpretation that improved when contradicted.”
“The bore reached a material boundary at 1,104 meters. We expected basalt or compacted sediment. Acoustic return was too coherent. We rotated the probe.”
“The probe rotated another thirty without command.”
“Possible. Then telemetry dropped for sixty seconds at all six sites.”
spans.speaker: nico

spans.text_exact: “The chain became emotionally satisfying before it became evidentially defensible,”
spans.speaker: pike

spans.text_exact: “He was not stupid. He was embarrassed. Then angry. Then convinced the debunking was part of the cover-up.”
“I marked every piece of equipment I personally verified after that. Not because the symbol meant anything. Because I needed one thing in the room whose meaning I controlled.”
“Because if this responds again, you need to know that being right about one impossible thing does not make you right about the next ten.”
